settings.models: All8 saved item/hypothesis slots; deduplicate identical roles+encoded parameter vectors, no refit

settings.normalization: Native objective=-marginal logLik/N, N=1000. Gradient in constrained free coordinates (shared anchors sum both groups). Gate1e-5 remains unchanged; total logLik score=-N*native gradient.

settings.finite_differences: Independent likelihood central differences for ALL free coordinates at GH61 and GH161, h=(1e-4 or1e-5)*max(1,abs(p_j)); exact same baseline parameters, no optimization. Record FD/analytic discrepancy and perturbation logLik changes; no new statistical acceptance limit.
settings.physical_sensitivity: Chain rule from b0/log gaps to shared/group physical thresholds and logSD to SD; report both bases, gate remains on native encoded coordinates.
settings.decision: Compare saved solutions across fixed grids; report whether same1e-5 native score gate exceeded at each. Distinguish integration-grid sensitivity, sign/scale, derivative correctness and numerical stability. No model fit, MC, Hessian optimization, p unlocking or threshold change.
